meta.label: Log Cleaner
meta.description: Scan and delete ROTATED DSS log files (*.log.<n>, *.log.*.gz, dated rotations) under whitelisted DIP_HOME roots. Live *.log files are never touched; the whitelist and min-age policy are enforced inside this macro.

params.name: roots
params.label: Roots
params.description: Comma-separated roots relative to DIP_HOME (subset of the whitelist: run, jobs, scenarios, code-envs/logs, analysis-data/logs, exports/logs, tmp/webappruns). Empty = all.

params.name: min_age_days
params.label: Minimum age (days)
params.description: Only rotated logs older than this are eligible.

params.name: max_delete_gb
params.label: Delete cap (GB)
params.description: Abort if the delete candidates exceed this total size.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: When true, list what would be deleted without deleting.
